trades.headline: Sell Henry while his season rank still looks good and get Higgins, a WR6 with a steady role.

bullets.text: Henry is RB11 on the season but only RB46 over the last four weeks, so you sell him at his season-long standing while his recent form has dipped.
bullets.fact_text: Derrick Henry (RB, BAL) scored 15.1 points per game over 9 games before the trade. His Season rank is RB11, by total points this season. His Recent rank is RB46, by points per game over the last 4 weeks.

bullets.text: Higgins is WR6 and scores 17 points per game, with a steady snap and target share, so he is a firm WR starter for you.
bullets.fact_text: Tee Higgins (WR, CIN) scored 17 points per game over 8 games before the trade. His Season rank is WR6, by total points this season.

bullets.text: Your RBs in the top 36 go from 3 to 2, so you keep two RBs who start and are not giving up your last reliable one.
bullets.fact_text: For Lil Fridge, the RBs in the top 36 go from 3 to 2.

bullets.text: Henry has historically been strong late in the season and in cold weather, which gives Teehee a reason to buy a back who is slumping now.
bullets.fact_text: In 2023, Derrick Henry played for TEN and scored half PPR points per game as follows: 13.71 in weeks 1 to 8 over 7 games; 12.82 in weeks 9 to 17 over 9 games; 17.7 in cold games over 1 game. In 2024, Derrick Henry played for BAL and scored half PPR points per game as follows: 21.4 in weeks 1 to 8 over 8 games; 15.82 in weeks 9 to 17 over 8 games; 18.57 in cold games over 3 games. In 2025, Derrick Henry played for BAL and scored half PPR points per game as follows: 12.84 in weeks 1 to 8 over 7 games; 18.83 in weeks 9 to 17 over 9 games; 21.58 in cold games over 5 games. A cold game is outdoors at 40 degrees F or below.

trades.headline: Henry for St. Brown turns a cooling back into a WR8 with a big target share, if you trust the passing game.

bullets.text: St. Brown is WR8 at 15.6 points per game and gives your WR group real weight.
bullets.fact_text: Amon-Ra St. Brown (WR, DET) scored 15.6 points per game over 8 games before the trade. His Season rank is WR8, by total points this season.

bullets.text: Your WRs in the top 36 go from 2 to 3 and you still hold two RBs, so the lineup gets deeper where it was thin.
bullets.fact_text: For Lil Fridge, the WRs in the top 36 go from 2 to 3.
